name: De Broglie Wavelength and Wave-Particle Duality
methods: Determine relativistic or non-relativistic momentum p
Calculate matter wavelength lambda = h / p
Relate group velocity of matter wave packet to classical particle velocity
Analyze electron diffraction through crystal lattices
problem_types: Electron diffraction in TEM and Davisson-Germer setup
De Broglie wavelength of accelerated thermal neutrons and molecules
Resolving power of electron microscopy vs optical microscopy
pitfalls: Using non-relativistic p = mv when particle kinetic energy is relativistic
Confusing phase velocity (which can exceed c) with physical group velocity
